new_jobs.description:
"All of my students came back in the top 1% for growth and achievement on their MAP scores."

— Sam DePalo, Lead Guide, Alpha Fort Worth Texas

Alpha is hiring.

On-site at the Alpha School campus in Brownsville, TX
$100,000/year W2 salary, paid weekly. Day-one health benefits.
Relocation support for a one-school-year campus commitment

You've spent years coordinating youth programs — not teaching them. You know the difference: a coordinator connects, challenges, and refuses to let a student settle for less than their best. A teacher delivers content. You've never been a content delivery system.

Alpha runs the most unconventional school you've ever seen. Students don't sit in rows being lectured. They advance through AI-powered learning apps at their own pace. AI handles the instructional content. Your job is to run life skills workshops that hold a room of K-8 students' attention, run motivation sessions that get them to hit their weekly learning goals, and hold the line when a student wants to coast. The academics take care of themselves. You handle the human part.

This role has a ceiling worth aiming at, and the ceiling is deeper student impact. Those who consistently hit their numbers (100% of cohort meeting weekly app goals, 90%+ satisfaction scores) grow into Lead Guide roles where they coach other educators on how to do this work better. Students stay the point.

The campus is in Brownsville, next door to SpaceX's Starbase. If your reason to leave your current job is the mission — changing what a kid believes about themselves — not the line on your resume, apply.

What You Will Be Doing

Running one-hour life skills workshops with K-8 students covering public speaking, focus, and giving and receiving feedback
Delivering Test2Pass mastery assessments after each workshop to confirm students have genuinely learned the skill, not just sat through it
Running daily motivation sessions using student profiles, interests, and Coachbot analytics to get 100% of your cohort hitting their weekly app advancement goals
Applying storytelling, incentives (school currency, leaderboards), and personal connection to push past student resistance
Tracking cohort satisfaction scores toward a 90%+ target on student surveys

What You Won’t Be Doing

Standing at a board and lecturing. Students advance academically through self-guided AI-powered apps, not through instruction from you.
Babysitting. Kids on computers is the setting; active engagement is the job.
Lowering the bar when students push back. Test2Pass standards hold, regardless of whether a student is having a hard week.
Inventing curriculum from scratch. Lesson plans and workshop playbooks are provided; your job is to deliver them with the presence and storytelling skill that makes students actually absorb the material.
Managing parents, running admissions, or overseeing campus operations. That's a different role.

Youth Program Coordinator Key Responsibilities

Coach a cohort of K-8 students to meet 100% of their weekly academic goals while delivering life skills workshops with 90%+ satisfaction scores.

Basic Requirements

Bachelor's degree in any subject
At least 3 years of experience working directly with K-8 (elementary and middle school) students
Compelling storytelling and facilitation presence — able to hold a room of children engaged for an hour
Willing to work on-site at the Alpha campus in Brownsville, TX
Legal right to work in the US without visa sponsorship

Nice-to-have Requirements

Background as an athletic coach, camp counselor, or youth program facilitator
Track record of high performance in a competitive environment (academic, athletic, or professional)
Experience working in a self-directed or app-based learning environment

About Alpha

Join the team building school around student growth

Alpha reimagines the school day around faster learning, stronger mentorship, and more time for students to build real-world skills.

Roles with real student impact:
Alpha hires teachers (guides), operators, admissions experts, school & curriculum leaders, and remote team members.

Education work that pays like it matters:
Alpha offers six-figure roles for people ready to help build a radically better school experience.

A culture built for builders:
Alpha is fast-moving, ambitious, and student focused. It’s for people who want to improve the system, not maintain it.

Alpha is where you can do the most meaningful work of your career.

There is so much to cover for this exciting role, and space here is limited. Hit the Apply button if you found this interesting and want to learn more. We look forward to meeting you!

: Project Coordinator

Job Description

As part of the AWC Implementation Team, the Project Coordinator (PC) helps coordinate the successful delivery of Emergency Responder Communications Enhancement Systems (ERCES) from initial requirements gathering through project closeout.

This role works closely with customers, Fire Marshals, AHJs, Radio Managers, subcontractors, and internal teams to coordinate project requirements, permitting, documentation, testing, inspections, and system commissioning. The ideal candidate is customer-service oriented, reliable, detail-oriented, willing to learn, and committed to AWC’s standards for quality and integrity.

Responsibilities

Communicate with Fire Marshals, inspectors, Radio Managers, and other Authorities Having Jurisdiction (AHJs) across the country to gather requirements for the design, installation, and operation of ERCES systems.
Coordinate project activities related to AHJ discovery, site surveys, permitting, submittals, testing, inspections, and closeout.
Maintain comprehensive project documentation using AWC’s internal file system.
Develop and maintain project trackers, checklists, submittals, and other documentation needed to keep projects on track.
Review project documents, including designs, scopes of work, and other project deliverables.
Stay current on applicable national and state codes and standards, including IBC, IFC, NFPA, and NEC, as they relate to ERCES projects.
Maintain and update AWC’s internal AHJ database.
Determine and communicate baseline testing requirements for planned ERCES systems and scopes of work.
Coordinate post-construction activities, including system data collection, inspections, and acceptance testing as required by the AHJ.
Coordinate, track, and verify subcontractor work related to AHJ discovery, site surveys, permitting, and submittals.
Attend virtual and in-person project and stakeholder meetings.
Communicate project issues that may affect completion, schedule, budget, or customer expectations to the Implementation/Service Manager and customer.
Build and maintain strong relationships with customers, subcontractors, and other project stakeholders.
Ensure project work meets AWC’s “Gold Standard” expectations for quality and customer service.
Perform other related duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.
Previous experience in public safety, land mobile radio, telecommunications, ERCES, Cellular DAS, or a related industry preferred.
CAPM or NICET-IBPSC certification, or willingness to work toward certification.
Working knowledge of IBC, IFC, NFPA, and NEC codes and standards as they relate to ERCES projects.
Ability to interpret blueprints, designs, scopes of work, and other project documentation.
Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.
Ability to meet customer deadlines and serve as a key point of contact for AWC/customer project issues.
Strong verbal and written communication skills.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Bluebeam, project management tools, and other computer applications.
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment and adapt to changing priorities.
Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Willingness and ability to travel as needed.
Valid driver’s license.
Ability to lift up to 30 pounds.

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for someone who is organized, dependable, comfortable communicating with a variety of stakeholders, and eager to learn the technical and regulatory requirements of ERCES projects. If you enjoy coordinating moving parts, solving problems, working with customers, and seeing projects through from discovery to completion, this could be a great fit.
